name: Night Loiter
description: Suburban home driveway on a very windy overcast day. A woman in blue athletic clothing stands in the driveway, leaning forward as strong wind gusts blow her long blonde hair wildly. Daytime overcast lighting with visible wind effects on clothing and hair.
